app.name: Maimaita Kalmar Fonetik
app.tagline: Horar da kai game da sauti, ƙarfafa rubutun — sauti ɗaya lokaci ɗaya.

home.heroIntro: Duba (ko ji) yadda ake karanta kalma, rubuta kalmar da take wakiltar. Gwaje-gwaje uku a kowace kalma, tarihin launi-keɓaɓɓu, da lada za su sa ka dawo.
home.continueLast: Ci gaba daga inda ka ƙare
home.rule1: Ana nuna maka rubutun lafazin kalma — rubuta kalmar.
home.rule2: Gwaje uku a kowace kalma: shudi a farkon gwaji, rawaya na biyu, ja na uku.
home.rule3: Shawarwari na bayyana haruffa, amma shawarwari uku sun yi da gazawa ɗaya.
home.rule4: Amsoshin daidai suna ba XP. Haɗakarwa, jere da yini, da kuma tukwici 16 suna jiran ka.
home.ttsNo: Babu muryar furta maka wannan harshe

classic.name: Rubutun Gargajiya
classic.tagline: Karanta sautin lafazi, rubuta kalmar. Kalubalen asali.

choice.name: Zaɓi Ɗaya
choice.tagline: Zaɓuka huɗu, sauti ɗaya daidai. Sauƙaƙan farawa.

listen.name: Saurara, Rubuta
listen.tagline: Babu alamomi — kai kaɗai. Ana furta kalma da iska.

speed.name: Kalubalen Gaggawa
speed.tagline: Daƙiƙa 60. Haɗakarwa har zuwa x3. Nemi maki mafi kyau.

daily.name: Kalubalen Yini
daily.tagline: Kalmomi 10 da aka ƙaddara — kalubale guda ga kowa, kowace yini.

review.name: Maimaitawa
review.tagline: Kalmomin da ba ka taɓa sanewa za su dawo har ka koya su.

play.question: Rubuta kalmar
play.typePlaceholder: Rubuta kalmar da ka ji/ka gani…
play.choicePrompt: Wace kalma ta dace da sautin?
play.noMoreHints: Babu ƙarin shawara don wannan kalma
play.skipConfirmBody: Fasa ana ƙidaya ta azamar gazawa a cikin ƙididdigarka.
play.listenPrompt: Saurara da kyau, sannan rubuta kalmar
play.speechUnavailable: Magana da murya ba ta nan a wannan burauzar. Gwaji da yanayin Gargajiya.
play.loadError: Ba a iya loda fakin kalmomin ba. Duba haɗin yanar gizon ka ka sake gwadawa.
play.dailyAlreadyDone: Kalubalen yau ya ƙare — dawo gobe, ko kuwa sake wasa don horarwa.
play.perfectSession: Zaman cikakke! Dukkan kalmomi a farkon gwaji!
play.reviewNothingDue: Babu abin da za a maimaita a yanzu — amsa wasu kalmomi farko, masu wahala za su dawo.

stats.title: Ƙididdigata
stats.dailyEmpty: Kammala kalubalen yini na farko don cika kalandar.
stats.historyEmpty: Babu kalma da aka gwada tukuna. Buga zaman don fara tarihin ka.
stats.historyNote: Danna kalma don binciko ta a Wiktionary.
stats.resetConfirmBody: XP, ƙididdiga, tarihi da tukwici za a gina su gaba ɗaya. Ba za a iya dawowa ba.
stats.noData: Buga zaman farko don ganin ƙididdiga a nan.
stats.v1Import: An sami ci gaban v1 an shigo da shi.
stats.v1ImportFound: Shigo da ci gaban v1 naka

settings.title: Saituna
settings.matchingHint: Yanayin haƙuri ya karɓi 'cafe' don 'café'. Yanayin tsauri yana buƙatar alamin sauti.
settings.pinyin: Amince da amsoshi pinyin na harshen Sinanci (taron gwaji)
settings.pinyinHint: Idan an kunsa, rubuta pinyin (kamar 'ma') za a ɗauka daidai ne ga kalmomin Sinanci. Rubuta haruffa koyaushe yana daidai — wannan ba ta hukunta rubutun asali ba.
